name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PArrIs.of_out
typeText:
∀ {m m' : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {P : Nat} {l : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} Nat Nat)},
  LE.le.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) →
    Eq.{1} (m' P) (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) →
      Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.pairsAt m' (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP)) l →
        DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RecsIn m' (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP)
            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) 1) (List.length.{0} l))
            (m' DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) →
          LE.le.{0}
              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) 1) (List.length.{0} l))
              (m' DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) →
            DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PArrIs m' P l

source.code:
theorem PArrIs.of_out {m m' : Mem} {P : ℕ} {l : List (ℕ × ℕ)} (hhp : IN ≤ m HP) (hP : m' P = m HP)
    (harr : pairsAt m' (m HP) = l) (hrec : RecsIn m' (m HP) (m HP + 1 + l.length) (m' HP))
    (hroom : m HP + 1 + l.length ≤ m' HP) : PArrIs m' P l := by
  have hlen : m' (m HP) = l.length := by rw [← harr, pairsAt, List.length_map, arrAt_length]
  refine ⟨⟨by rw [hP]; exact hhp, by rw [hP, hlen]; exact hroom, ?_⟩, by rw [hP]; exact harr⟩
  rw [hP]; exact hrec.mono (by omega) le_rfl
